authority_note: Final authority is the official Chainlink Robinhood price-feed catalog and Robinhood Chain documentation. A binding is added here ONLY after its proxy address, description, decimals and heartbeat were verified against that official authority; third-party repositories are discovery hints only. An asset without a binding is ORACLE_FEED_NOT_REVIEWED. No address is inferred from a ticker. The L2 sequencer authority is recorded separately in `sequencer_authority`: `sequencer` stays null because NO sequencer uptime feed proxy is source-proven.
